description: Inventory of the current production fetch path. Entries marked baseline_only have not undergone source-specific benchmarking; assessed entries record evidence and keep production changes separate from evaluation.

defaults.access_policy: Public pages only; obey robots.txt, site terms, rate limits and Retry-After; never bypass 403/429, login walls or CAPTCHA.

entries.assessment_note: 2026-11-10 pilot: Scrapling and lxml retained 7/7 relevant anchor labels. Trafilatura Markdown retained 1/17 exact relevant href targets. Italian and English sitemap children yielded 81 and 19 keyword-match URLs respectively. Keep Scrapling; use sitemap only as secondary URL discovery, then deduplicate and verify dates/relevance.
entries.parser_decision: keep_scrapling; lxml is a structural fallback candidate; Trafilatura is not the default

entries.assessment_note: 2026-11-10 pilot: the dedicated auditions sitemap child yielded 85 keyword-match URLs among five of seven child maps inspected. The public WordPress API root returned valid JSON with 402 routes; no route endpoint was queried. Two advertised feeds had zero entries. Scrapling retained 119/119 relevant labels; Trafilatura Markdown retained 180/332 exact href targets. Keep Scrapling and use sitemap as secondary discovery; API routes and Trafilatura remain unpromoted.
entries.parser_decision: keep_scrapling; do not promote Trafilatura without a structured-link comparison
